title: stim-seizures (Ojemann et al.; HUP + CHOP): seizure annotations, electrode localisations and preprocessed SEEG seizure traces (derivative)
description: A derivative BIDS-iEEG repackaging of processed data from the stim-seizures release (Ojemann, Litt, Conrad). It covers patients from the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania and the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia who received low-frequency (1 Hz) electrical stimulation during intracranial EEG evaluation. It includes clinician and LSTM-model seizure annotations, electrode localisations with atlas labels, and four preprocessed bipolar SEEG seizure traces. It contains no raw iEEG recordings.
methods_description: Patients underwent intracranial EEG monitoring and 1 Hz electrical stimulation. Seizures were annotated by clinicians and by an optimized LSTM model. Electrodes were localised to atlas labels. Seizure traces were preprocessed to bipolar SEEG at 128 Hz and stored as BrainVision float32.
